frontend:
    # Served behind oauth2-proxy (docker-compose) which owns http://localhost:3000
    # and enforces the Keycloak login before proxying to this dev server.
    command: pnpm dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3002
    working_dir: ./01-frontend/frontend
    environment:
      - VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding
      # Browser-facing URLs: localhost, or the public https://<port>-$WEB_HOST values that
      # create_secrets.sh wrote to .env. The S3 origins must equal the origin of the presigned
      # URLs (S3_EXTERNAL_URL on the document-management service below).
      - VITE_API_BASE_URL=${FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_APP_BASE_PATH=/app
      - VITE_TEMPORAL_UI_BASE_URL=${TEMPORAL_UI_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_ORIGINS=${S3_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_ALLOWED_UPLOAD_ORIGINS=${S3_PUBLIC_URL}
      - VITE_PLS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18000/openapi.json
      - VITE_DMS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18001/openapi.json
      - VITE_FCS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18002/openapi.json
      - VITE_AOM_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18003/openapi.json
      - VITE_TEMPORAL_JOBS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18015/openapi.json
      - VITE_PNS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18005/openapi.json
      - VITE_OMS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18006/openapi.json
      - VITE_SUPPLEMENTARY_REQUESTS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18012/openapi.json
      - VITE_COMMENTS_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18008/openapi.json
      - VITE_EXAMINATION_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18009/openapi.json
      - VITE_VAE_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18010/openapi.json
      - VITE_LAW_CHANGES_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18024/openapi.json
      - VITE_IDENTITY_MANAGEMENT_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18013/openapi.json
      - VITE_FEEDBACK_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18011/openapi.json
      - VITE_PROTOCOL_OPENAPI_URL=http://localhost:18016/openapi.json
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_ID=${LOCAL_USER_ID}
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_EMAIL=${LOCAL_USER_EMAIL}
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME=${LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME}
      - VITE_LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME=${LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME}
      - ALLOW_DEV_MODE=true
      - VITE_ENABLE_EWMS_FEATURE=true
      - VITE_ENABLE_AUTH_REDIRECT_RETRY=true
      - VITE_SYSTEM_LOAD_DISABLE_THRESHOLD_PERCENTAGE=500

    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 3002
        path: /app/
      initial_delay_seconds: 10
      period_seconds: 5
    depends_on:
      project-logic:
        condition: process_healthy
      project-logic-seed:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      document-management:
        condition: process_healthy
      formal-completeness:
        condition: process_healthy
      formal-completeness-seed:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      agent-orchestration:
        condition: process_healthy
      plausibility-notes:
        condition: process_healthy
      objections-management:
        condition: process_healthy
      comment:
        condition: process_healthy
      examination:
        condition: process_healthy
      administrative-file-draft:
        condition: process_healthy
      administrative-file-draft-seed:
        condition: process_completed_successfully
      feedback:
        condition: process_healthy
      supplementary-requests:
        condition: process_healthy
      identity-management:
        condition: process_healthy
      temporal-job:
        condition: process_healthy
      protocol:
